name: bf-nonresident-services-withholding
description: Burkina Faso non-resident services withholding for 2026: determine payer and service scope, classify ordinary services versus exclusively road carriage of goods, include incidental expenses, calculate withholding and prepare the monthly declaration information. Use it for foreign consultancy, technical assistance, intellectual property payments, head-office charges and road-freight service payments provided or used locally. It records the statutory remittance deadline, individual certificate requirement and separate failure branches, with two executable cases. Treaty entitlement, permanent establishments, investment income and VAT require separate work. Current portal boxes have not been verified and no accountant has attested to this draft.
